correctness.rationale: The directed Euler-trail criterion is necessary and sufficient for nonempty support; on adjoining an arc from end to start, the balanced weakly connected multigraph admits an Euler circuit. The loop-only and two-vertex terms exclude detached loops. All-three-active off-diagonal support is connected on three vertices. Cycle net flows are (k,k,k) at balance and (k,k−1,k−1) for one ordered endpoint pair; arbitrary antiparallel pairs give the factors (1−z²)^(-3). The subtraction of two-vertex and zero supports and the sixfold endpoint multiplier are correct. Independently cleared the denominators to verify the full rational identity, checked the pole coefficient 7/12 at z=1, and enumerated the reachable (profile, last symbol) pairs by single-symbol extension through n=20. This gives the advertised coefficients including the single zero-profile at n=1 and also A_20=125607. Replay: `python3 /workspace/branches/frozen_replay.py 2`.
residual_risks: The finite extension census corroborates but does not substitute for the exact Euler/support decomposition and formal identity.
